major_cooldowns.name: Ascendance
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use as your primary damage cooldown during bloodlust or burst windows.

major_cooldowns.name: Feral Spirit
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use strictly on cooldown to generate Maelstrom Weapon and provide elemental buffs.

major_cooldowns.name: Doom Winds
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use stacked with Feral Spirit to rapidly generate Maelstrom via Windfury attacks.

major_cooldowns.name: Primordial Wave
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Use on cooldown to apply Flame Shock and prepare a massive AoE Lightning Bolt.

defensives.name: Astral Shift
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively to reduce all damage taken by 40%.

defensives.name: Earth Elemental
defensives.usage_rule: Use for the passive maximum health increase during periods of high sustained damage.

defensives.name: Healing Surge
defensives.usage_rule: Use Maelstrom Weapon stacks to instantly heal yourself when in critical danger.

rules.description: Stack Doom Winds and Feral Spirit
rules.action: Ensure Feral Spirit and Doom Winds are always used together for maximum synergy.
Spend Maelstrom Weapon on Lightning Bolt or Elemental Blast as soon as you reach 8 to 10 stacks to avoid wasting generation.
Ensure Flame Shock is active on the primary target at all times to enable Lava Lash.

source_summary: Enhancement Shaman is a highly reactive spec dependent on rapidly spending Maelstrom Weapon stacks. Burst windows are defined by overlapping Feral Spirit, Doom Winds, and potentially Ascendance to flood the shaman with resources.
